    opacity: 0;

  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
}

    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);

    transform: translate3d(-30px, 0, 0);

    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
}

  from {
    opacity: 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(30px, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(30px, 0, 0);
  }

  to {
    opacity: 1;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
}

  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translate3d(30px, 0, 0);
  }

    transform: translate3d(0, 0, 0);
  }
}

  from {
    opacity: 0;
    -webkit-transform: translate3d(0, 30px, 0);
    transform: translate3d(0, 30px, 0);
  }

				document.body.appendChild(lightbox);
				lightbox.querySelector('[data-unicorn-marketo-close]').onclick = function () {

				};

			if (!title) {
				title = document.createElement('h2');
				title.className = 'unicorn-marketo-modal__title';
				title.setAttribute('data-unicorn-marketo-title', '');
				lightbox.querySelector('.unicorn-marketo-modal__dialog').appendChild(title);
			}

			var mount = lightbox.querySelector('[data-unicorn-marketo-form]');
			if (!mount) {
				mount = document.createElement('div');
				mount.className = 'unicorn-marketo-modal__form';
				mount.setAttribute('data-unicorn-marketo-form', '');

		document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
			var lightbox = document.getElementById('unicorn-gravity-marketo-lightbox');
			if ('Escape' === event.key && lightbox && lightbox.classList.contains('is-open')) {
				closeModal(lightbox);
			}
		});

		function ensureMarketoForms(callback) {
			if (window.MktoForms2 && window.MktoForms2.loadForm) {
				callback(true);
				return;
			}

			var script = document.querySelector('script[src="' + config.scriptUrl + '"]');
			var finished = false;
			var finish = function () {
				if (finished) {
					return;
				}
				finished = true;
				callback(!!(window.MktoForms2 && window.MktoForms2.loadForm));
			};

			if (!script) {
				script = document.createElement('script');
				script.src = config.scriptUrl;
				script.async = true;
				document.head.appendChild(script);
			}
			script.addEventListener('load', finish, {once: true});
			script.addEventListener('error', finish, {once: true});
			window.setTimeout(finish, 10000);
		}

		function loadMarketoForm(mapping, mount, email, formId, data, pendingToken) {
			ensureMarketoForms(function (available) {
				if (!available) {
					mount.innerHTML = '<p>Unable to load the next form. Please try again.</p>';
					return;
				}

				var marketoElementId = 'mktoForm_' + mapping.marketoFormId;
				var existingMarketoForm = document.getElementById(marketoElementId);
				if (existingMarketoForm && !mount.contains(existingMarketoForm)) {
					existingMarketoForm.__unicornOriginalId = marketoElementId;
					existingMarketoForm.id = marketoElementId + '-unicorn-existing';
					var lightbox = document.getElementById('unicorn-gravity-marketo-lightbox');
					if (lightbox) {
						lightbox.__unicornDisplacedMarketoForm = existingMarketoForm;
					}
				}
				mount.innerHTML = '<div class="logic-monitor-form logic-monitor-form--light" data-form-id="' + mapping.marketoFormId + '"><form id="' + marketoElementId + '" class="mktoForm"></form></div>';
				window.MktoForms2.loadForm(config.baseUrl, config.munchkinId, mapping.marketoFormId, function (form) {
				var lightbox = document.getElementById('unicorn-gravity-marketo-lightbox');
				var values = {};
				var sourceData = data && typeof data === 'object' ? data : {};
				var placeholderData = capturedPlaceholderValues[String(formId)] || {};
				var formElement = form.getFormElem ? form.getFormElem() : null;
				if (formElement && formElement.find) {
					formElement.find('input, select, textarea').each(function () {
						var fieldName = this.name || '';
						var placeholder = this.getAttribute('placeholder') || '';
						if (!fieldName) {
							return;
						}
						if (placeholder && Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(placeholderData, normalizeFieldName(placeholder))) {
							values[fieldName] = placeholderData[normalizeFieldName(placeholder)];
							return;
						}
						Object.keys(sourceData).some(function (sourceKey) {
							if (normalizeFieldName(sourceKey) === normalizeFieldName(fieldName)) {
								values[fieldName] = sourceData[sourceKey];
								return true;
							}
							return false;
						});
					});
				}
				if (email && !values.Email) {
					values.Email = email;
				}
				if (form.vals && Object.keys(values).length) {
					form.vals(values);
				}
				if (lightbox) {
					lightbox.__unicornMarketoForm = form;
				}
				if (form.onSuccess) {
					form.onSuccess(function () {
						if (lightbox) {
							lightbox.__unicornMarketoSubmitted = true;
						}
						jQuery.post('https://www.logicmonitor.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
							action: 'unicorn_marketo_clear_pending',
							email: email,
							form_id: formId,
							pending_token: pendingToken,
							nonce: config.nonce
						});
						return true;
					});
				}
				if (lightbox && lightbox.__unicornMarketoCloseRequested) {
					if (!lightbox.__unicornMarketoRestEnabled && form.submit) {
						closeModal(lightbox);
					} else if (lightbox.__unicornMarketoRestEnabled) {
						restoreDisplacedMarketoForm(lightbox);
					}
				}
				});
			});
		}

		function openModal(formId, email, data, pendingToken) {
			var mapping = getMapping(formId);
			if (!mapping) {
				return;
			}

			var elements = getOrCreateLightbox();
			elements.title.textContent = mapping.title || 'Continue';
			elements.mount.innerHTML = '';
			elements.lightbox.__unicornMarketoForm = null;
			elements.lightbox.__unicornMarketoRestEnabled = !!mapping.restEnabled;
			elements.lightbox.__unicornMarketoPendingToken = pendingToken || '';
			elements.lightbox.__unicornMarketoSubmitted = false;
			elements.lightbox.__unicornMarketoCloseRequested = false;
			elements.lightbox.classList.add('is-open');
			elements.lightbox.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
			document.documentElement.classList.add('scroll-lock');
			document.body.classList.add('scroll-lock');
			window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
				if (elements.lightbox.focus) {
					elements.lightbox.focus({preventScroll: true});
				}
			});
			loadMarketoForm(mapping, elements.mount, email, formId, data, pendingToken);
		}

		function preparePending(formId, email, pendingToken, callback) {
			if (!email && !pendingToken) {
				callback({}, email, pendingToken);
				return;
			}
			jQuery.post('https://www.logicmonitor.com/wp-admin/admin-ajax.php', {
				action: 'unicorn_marketo_pending',
				email: email,
				form_id: formId,
				pending_token: pendingToken,
				nonce: config.nonce
			}).done(function (response) {
				var pending = response && response.success && response.data ? response.data : {};
				callback(pending.data || {}, pending.email || email, pendingToken);
			}).fail(function () {
				callback({}, email, pendingToken);
			});
		}

		function openPendingConfirmations() {
			document.querySelectorAll('[data-unicorn-marketo-confirmation="1"]').forEach(function (confirmation) {
				var formId = confirmation.getAttribute('data-form-id');
				var mapping = getMapping(formId);
				var input = getEmailInput(formId, mapping);
				var email = capturedEmails[String(formId)] || confirmation.getAttribute('data-email') || (input ? input.value : '');
				var pendingToken = confirmation.getAttribute('data-pending-token') || '';
				preparePending(formId, email, pendingToken, function (data, resolvedEmail, resolvedToken) {
					openModal(formId, resolvedEmail, data, resolvedToken);
				});
			});
		}

		jQuery(document).on('gform_pre_submission', function (event, formId) {
			var input = getEmailInput(formId, getMapping(formId));
			if (input) capturedEmails[String(formId)] = input.value;
			captureGravityFormPlaceholders(formId);
		});
		jQuery(document).on('gform_confirmation_loaded', function (event, formId) {
			var mapping = getMapping(formId);
			var input = getEmailInput(formId, mapping);
			var confirmation = null;
			document.querySelectorAll('[data-unicorn-marketo-confirmation="1"]').forEach(function (candidate) {
				if (!confirmation && candidate.getAttribute('data-form-id') === String(formId)) {
					confirmation = candidate;
				}
			});
			var email = capturedEmails[String(formId)] || (confirmation ? confirmation.getAttribute('data-email') : '') || (input ? input.value : '');
			var pendingToken = confirmation ? confirmation.getAttribute('data-pending-token') || '' : '';
			preparePending(formId, email, pendingToken, function (data, resolvedEmail, resolvedToken) {
				openModal(formId, resolvedEmail, data, resolvedToken);
			});
		});

		if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
			document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', openPendingConfirmations, {once: true});
		} else {
			openPendingConfirmations();
		}
	})(window.UnicornGravityFormsMarketo);
	</script>
